Paul is showing that Jesus was from a different tribe, and was made a priest after the order of Melchisedec (Hebrews 7:11), who was the King of Salem when Abraham took the spoils of war, and paid a tithe to him. This was before the time of Moses and Aaron, and so it was greater than the Aaron priesthood, and it was prophesied (Psalms 110:4) that this would happen. This is why no person will be able to claim that they didn’t know they were sinning, as God has put it into our hearts when we are born, and we know when we are sinning. Praise God for this new covenant, where we, who are born again, won’t have to answer for all our sins and iniquities. This doesn’t mean you can just go sin, and not pay a price, as the devil will do you in if you yield to him by sinning (Romans 6:16), and he comes only to destroy you (John 10:10). Praise God for Jesus!
